title: Execution record (frozen draft)
description: Append-only record of one Agent execution. execution_id is not order. artifact_refs, resume pointers, and implementation-path names are intentionally absent.

schema_version.description: Git-side schema version. Not operational execution data.

mission_id.description: Join to Mission. Not a copy of Mission contents.

execution_sequence.description: Order within the same mission_id. Do not derive order from execution_id.

result_determination.description: Whether this execution's result is determined. Not an implementation-path name.

determined_result.description: Present only when result_determination is determined. Empty string is a determined empty result, not missing.

execution_end_state_judgment.description: Whether mission state was judged at this execution's end. not_judged is not a fifth mission state.

execution_end_state.description: Mission state at this execution's end only. Not the current mission-wide state.

goal_achievement_performed.description: Whether goal-achievement judgment ran. Auto judgment is not connected; writers currently store false.

goal_achievement_result.description: Present only when goal_achievement_performed is true.

stop_reason.description: Loop stop reason as input. Not mission state. Not a closed runtime enum copy.

unresolved_items.description: [] means zero unresolved items captured in this execution. Not proof that none exist.

evidence_refs.description: persistent_evidence_id values only. Bodies are not copied. May reference evidence created in another mission. [] means zero refs.

correlation_id.description: Optional Chat Turn reference. Not a substitute for mission_id or execution_id.
